verdict.rationale: Fathom documents official TypeScript and Python SDKs, with install pages (`npm install fathom-typescript`, a uvx-based Python setup), built-in handling of authentication, pagination, errors and rate-limit retries, OAuth 2.0 support, filtering guides and a `verifyWebhook` helper. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as documented, and any SDK languages beyond TypeScript and Python.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use our Typescript or Python SDK.
Get started in minutes with our official SDKs. They handle authentication, pagination, error handling, and all the complex stuff so you can focus on building amazing integrations.
The official SDKs automatically retry rate-limited requests, waiting for the duration indicated by the `Retry-After` header.
Both TypeScript and Python SDKs support OAuth 2.0 authentication for building integrations that can be installed by multiple Fathom accounts.
